notes.title: Sequel Announcement: The Jester and the Madman Coming later 2025
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]I'm happy to announce that Curse of the Old Gods is getting a sequel.[/p][p]Step into the shoes of Rick Moreton once again as he thwarts the plans of an evil doomsday cult.[/p][p][/p][p]This time, you'll be joined by a [b]second playable character[/b], Holly Bardot, who teams up with Rick in an exciting pulp fiction rollercoaster.[/p][p]The game's graphics are also getting an upgrade to SVGA resolution and a [b]mind-boggling 256 colors[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Have a look at the trailer and [b]wishlist[/b] the game to support development.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3893670/The_Jester_and_the_Madman/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Will you become the Jester or the Madman?[/p][p][/p][p]Coming to Steam later this year.[/p]

notes.title: Cantaloupe Chronicle - Available now!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]with great pleasure I announce that my newest game "Cantaloupe Chronicle" is now available on Steam for Windows and Linux.[/p][p][/p][p]In Cantaloupe Chronicle, you step into the shoes of a budding journalist on your first day as an intern at the town’s quirky newspaper, The Cantaloupe Chronicle. Set in a cozy roadside town filled with intrigue, this game invites you to explore a rich, atmospheric environment. Interact with eccentric locals, solve puzzles, and uncover stories that will shape your career as a reporter.[/p][p]The story centers on an old mystery, but the theme explores how not every story ends cleanly and how we learn to live without closure.[/p][p]What begins as a simple learning experience quickly turns into a quest to uncover the secrets of the town's past—including the mysterious case of a body found years ago.[/p][p]As you collect items, talk to the townsfolk, and solve engaging puzzles, you’ll craft articles using an innovative text editor system. Writing doesn’t feel daunting here—you can unlock text blocks from your investigations and insert them into articles with ease. From small-town gossip to the big front-page story, every article brings them closer to the ultimate truth.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p] Tim[/p]

notes.title: "Zarathustra - Cybergeddon" - New Free Adventure Game on itch.io
notes.content:
Hello fellow cultists and Lovecraft-Enjoyers,

I've just released the first two days (about 2-3 hours worth of gameplay) of a brand new adventure game over at itch.io.

[b]Get it here:[/b] [url=https://tim-rachor.itch.io/zarathustra]Download on itch.io[/url]

It's also heavily inspired by the works of Lovecraft, but takes quite a different turn than Curse of the Old Gods. It's set in an alternate future with cyberpunk and religious undertones... but don't worry: you still play an FBI agent trying to save the world!

I hope you give it a try and tell me if you enjoy it. :)

Cheers,
 Tim

notes.title: Update 1.07 with updated graphics released!
notes.content:
A new update for Curse of the Old Gods has been released!


Some of you had a hard time with the bright and unusual color palette of blues and purples. The new update introduces the option to switch to a vintage [b]black and white movie[/b] art-style. (You can find the option under settings "Bright Colors" in the smartphone in your inventory)

Additionally you can now save up to [b]15 different save games[/b]... your best chance to achieve all the different endings! 

Change Log:
-Introducing new optional art-style for the game
-Added save slot system for up to 15 save games
-Fixed bugs regarding aspec ratios and fullscreen switches
-Fixed compatibility issues
-Upgraded to newest Unity version

notes.title: Version 1.05 released!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31251389/2fdcb81c396e2217b23a4157a3e10b1c16a1dcb6.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

we've just released version [b]1.05[/b] of the game with a whole bunch of changes and improvements. Below you will find the change log with everything you need to know. Enjoy! 

[b]Improvements:[/b]
-You can now right-click to show interactable objects in the scene.
-Added two new secret achievements. Can you unlock them?
-Added several new interactions in the game and more comments from Agent Moreton.
-Added an animation to the notification icon to be more visible.
-Added some hints for the harder puzzles.
-Reduced the music volume for some songs.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
-Fixed a bug where hints stayed on the screen when an object was picked up.
-Fixed a bug where text and predestinations overlapped with other text boxes.
-Fixed several typos and improved overall text quality.
-Additional small fixes here and there.
